If you have access to mulch or compost, adding a thin layer around the base of the herbs can help retain moisture until the irrigation is fixed.

Check that the soil stays evenly moist but not soggy. Stick your finger about an inch into the soil—if it feels dry, water again; if it’s wet, hold off.

**4. Leaf Edges and Tips:**

**5. Pests or Disease:**
